variety_description: An average yielding, early maturing, medium tall, medium slender variety suitable for cultivation under rainfed lowland growing conditions. Developed by BRRI thru GSR project in collaboration with CAAS. Released in 2016 for planting in Aman season. Strong culm. Tolerant to lodging and grain shattering. Slightly aromatic premium quality rice with good taste. Tolerant to major diseases and insect pests.
